g.text: resolvers answer from their site nearest to you, so they show what people near you see,
All 7 global resolvers agree, and the 1 resolver that differs is in another country (Yandex in
Russia). Sites on a CDN or geo-DNS give each region its own nearby servers on purpose, so this is
normal for them. If you didn't just change this record, nothing is wrong.
If you did change it, check that the most common answer is the value you set: if it is,
the change has reached the resolvers near you. Run this again later: answers that are location-based
stay different, while stale ones catch up when their TTL runs out.
